RIKKU_OVERDRIVE.title: Overdrive
RIKKU_OVERDRIVE.description:
At 100 Overdrive, add [gold]Mix[/gold] to your hand. 

Gain 5 Overdrive at the start of your turn.
Gain 3 Overdrive whenever you play a card.
Gain 6 Overdrive whenever you play a [blue]Steal[/blue] card.
Gain 5 Overdrive whenever you use a Potion.
RIKKU_OVERKILL.title: Overkill
RIKKU_OVERKILL.description: When a killing blow deals damage equal to or greater than 20% of the target's Max HP, gain 10 additional Gold and 1 additional Potion at the end of combat. If the target was an Act Boss, gain an additional Relic. Only works on non-minion creatures.
RIKKU_MIX.title: Mix
RIKKU_MIX.description: Choose 2 Potions to Mix. The Primary determines the effect and only the Primary ingredient is consumed. Matching ingredients or an Uncommon Primary create a stronger Mix.
RIKKU_DISCARD_POTION.title: Discard Potion
RIKKU_DISCARD_POTION.description: You may discard a Potion of your choice to trigger this card's additional effect.
RIKKU_BURNING_SOUL.title: Burning Soul
RIKKU_BURNING_SOUL.description:
{BombFragmentIcon} + Any: 
Deal 40 damage and apply 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
{BombFragmentIcon} + {BombFragmentIcon} OR {FireGemIcon} + Any: 
Deal 51 damage and apply 3 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
RIKKU_WINTER_STORM.title: Winter Storm
RIKKU_WINTER_STORM.description:
{AntarcticWindIcon} + Any: 
Deal 35 damage to ALL enemies. Gain 12 [gold]Block[/gold] now and next turn.
{AntarcticWindIcon} + {AntarcticWindIcon} OR {IceGemIcon} + Any: 
Deal 45 damage to ALL enemies. Gain 16 [gold]Block[/gold] now and next turn.
RIKKU_LIGHTNING_BOLT.title: Lightning Bolt
RIKKU_LIGHTNING_BOLT.description:
{ElectroMarbleIcon} + Any: 
Deal 11 damage to random enemies 4 times. For 2 turns, deal 8 damage to a random enemy at the start of your turn.
{ElectroMarbleIcon} + {ElectroMarbleIcon} OR {LightningGemIcon} + Any: 
Hit 5 times and lasts 3 turns instead.
RIKKU_TIDAL_WAVE.title: Tidal Wave
RIKKU_TIDAL_WAVE.description:
{FishScaleIcon} + Any: 
Deal 40 damage and apply 2 [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
{FishScaleIcon} + {FishScaleIcon} OR {WaterGemIcon} + Any: 
Deal 51 damage and apply 3 [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
RIKKU_CHAOS_GRENADE.title: Chaos Grenade
RIKKU_CHAOS_GRENADE.description:
{FragGrenadeIcon} + Any: 
Deal 38 damage to ALL enemies.
{FragGrenadeIcon} + {FragGrenadeIcon} OR {SupremeGemIcon} + Any: 
Deal 48 damage to ALL enemies.

Deals 50% more damage if there is only 1 enemy.
RIKKU_MIGHTY_WALL.title: Mighty Wall
RIKKU_MIGHTY_WALL.description:
{LightCurtainIcon} + Any: 
ALL players gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold].
{LightCurtainIcon} + {LightCurtainIcon} OR {StarCurtainIcon} + Any: 
ALL players gain 2 [gold]Intangible[/gold].
RIKKU_HAZARDOUS_SHELL.title: Hazardous Shell
RIKKU_HAZARDOUS_SHELL.description:
No ingredients: 
Deal 28 damage to ALL enemies.
Any other ingredient combination: 
Deal 38 damage to ALL enemies.
